title: Unary Counter Initialization
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet and let $a,N\in\bbn$. For any input word, base configuration, input-head position, budget-head position and tape, and guide-head position and tape, starting in the unary-start phase with unary head at $N+1$ and unary tape containing $N$ markers, after $N+2$ steps the machine is in the first rightward layout phase with unary head at $1$; the resulting configuration has all the same data and other head positions.
hypotheses_covered: An input word and base configuration
Integer budget-head position and budget tape
Initial unary-start phase, unary head at $N+1$, and unary tape with $N$ markers
replaced:
From a setup configuration in the unary-start phase with unary head at cell $N+1$ over
the unary tape with $N$ markers, exactly $N+2$ steps rewind the entire newly
constructed unary segment and reach the first rightward layout phase with unary head at
cell $1$; all tapes and all other heads are unchanged.
